Carter (Support): FYI - AcmePay reporting a spike of 429s with requests routed to their Dedicated pool in eu-west1. customer says this started ~8:10 UTC.
Mike (Oncall): looking. any error samples? 429 body or 503?
Carter (Support): 429 with body 'rate_limit_exceeded'. also some clients see 502 from the gateway. Pasting minimal curl from customer:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/deployments/dedicated-acmepay/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-***' \
  -d '{"input":"test"}'
```
Lina (Customer Success): they said traffic is steady, not a sudden burst. SLA impacted, customer wants triage and mitigation.
Mike (Oncall): I see placement failures in the scheduler around 2426001100 in logs: `placement: defer - fragment_limit_reached for pool eu-west1-dedicated-acmepay`. Autoscaler didn't add nodes because quota check returned success but allocate returned 409.
Jennifer (Infra): digging into quotas now. quick note: there was a regional provisioning delay in eu-west1 starting at 2426001000 due to maintenance on our partner cloud. Some AZs are reporting GPU inventory inconsistencies.
Dinesh (Platform): Could be noisy neighbor causing eviction/slowdown. Are we seeing high EVict counts or OOMs on the nodes attached to that pool?
Mike (Oncall): evict log snippet: `evict: pod/gpu-serve-57 evicted reason=ResourcesUnavailable preempted_by=tenant-blue-01` repeated 12x between 2426001050-2426001180. Also KB shows kernel GPU memory pressure on one host.
Carter (Support): customer also reported auth errors after traffic rerouted to fallback region — they use region-scoped API keys per contract. Some fallbacks returned 401.
Lina (Customer Success): that's bad — we failed to respect region-binding during failover. they have a compliance playbook that requires EU-only keys.
Jennifer (Infra): timeline: 2426000950 partner maintenance begins -> 2426001000 inventory mismatch -> scheduler defers placement -> autoscaler issues allocation 2426001075 (409) -> scheduler marks pool degraded -> routing starts failover to eu-central at 2426001150.
Dinesh (Platform): Repro steps for infra team: 1) use internal test runner to simulate 200 concurrent connections to pool eu-west1-dedicated-acmepay; 2) watch scheduler logs and `kubectl get pods -o wide` for evictions; 3) run `curl -s -H "X-Region: eu-west1"` against the control plane to verify region-bound key acceptance.
Mike (Oncall): quick mitigation options: a) temporarily drain noisy tenant (tenant-blue-01) from affected AZs; b) open emergency capacity from our reserve pool in eu-west2 and announce to customer (requires manual approval); c) pause cross-region failover to avoid 401s and instead queue requests with grace 30s fallback. Thoughts?
Dinesh (Platform): I recommend (a) + (b). draining noisy tenant lowers immediate evictions. reserve pool spin-up will buy time while infra fixes partner account. (c) avoids auth issues but will worsen latency.
Lina (Customer Success): customer prefers (b) if possible, they want uninterrupted service in EU. they will accept short throttling but not cross-region data movement.
Carter (Support): I'm authorizing (b) for AcmePay as a one-time emergency. Mike, please coordinate reserve allocation and update runbook.
Mike (Oncall): on it. I'm kicking off reserve allocation request 2426001265 -> reserve-api returned `accepted` but provisioning stuck at 2426001340 with `backend: insufficient-gpu` — reassigning to infra.
Jennifer (Infra): partner cloud flagged a partial rollback in one AZ; I'm escalating to partner ops now. Also enabling temporary stricter pod anti-affinity for tenant-blue-01 so it doesn't consolidate on the same hosts.
Mike (Oncall): applied anti-affinity patch, starting eviction mitigation. traffic for AcmePay dropping 429s to ~1% now (was 12%).
Carter (Support): customer notified: "we're working to restore full capacity; you'll see reduced 429s and no cross-region failover". They acknowledged.
Dinesh (Platform): action items for postmortem: - fix autoscaler allocation retry path for 409 to trigger reserve fallback earlier - add region-scoped key check to routing fallback logic (avoid 401s) - improve noisy-tenant isolation heuristics - create synthetic test to simulate partner inventory drift every 6 hours.
Lina (Customer Success): I'll schedule customer follow-up and a credit for SLA hit.
Mike (Oncall): monitoring note: added temporary dashboard panels for `evictions/sec`, `placement.defer.count` and `reserve.alloc.latency`.
Carter (Support): closure plan: keep thread open until partner confirms AZ health + reserve pool stable for 24h. Next update by Mike in 30m. ops-bot: post summary and ticket to INC-8921.
ops-bot: Summary posted to INC-8921 and pinged partner-ops channel.
Mike (Oncall): update: partner confirmed AZ degraded components replaced at 2426005030. reserve pool now stable. marking incident mitigated.
Carter (Support): thanks all. preparing CS post-incident note for customer and linking the repro steps.
Lina (Customer Success): sending follow-up to AcmePay now.
Mike (Oncall): recording the timeline and actions to the incident tracker. will start postmortem doc later today.
Carter (Support): closing thread in 24h if no regressions.
